main_measure.name: mean unusual 5-bar move per long bet (return minus coin's normal 5-bar drift)

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases pooled by day

main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with day-pooled t >= 2 and graded-size check passes; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: graded size: mean unusual move of cases with forecast above the cases' median minus that at or below

decided_by: The mean unusual move is above 0 with t >= 2 and the graded-size check passes.
reading: Bets are rises of the positive forecast of at least 2 points from its lowest level since the last bet (reset to 0 when flat), the first bet in each 5-bar cell counted from each window's first row; the normal drift is the mean of each coin's non-overlapping 5-bar returns on that grid over all windows; the t sums deviations per signal day (UTC date) with a D/(D-1) correction; the plan's 'fewer than 30 distinct case days' is applied as a minimum count, giving 'not observable'.

direction_check.why: main measure +0.01427 on the check folds against +0.01747 on every fold
